1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 c5 3.e3 g6 4.Nc3 Bg7 5.Nf3.strategy: A modest developing move that prepares castling and keeps the e3-d4 pawn chain intact. White is content with a solid set-up and does not grab space, so Black can challenge the centre at once and has no problems in the opening.

Trades the c-pawn for White's central d-pawn. It opens the c-file for Black's rook and leaves the d4 pawn a target for the fianchettoed bishop once the f6 knight steps aside. The exchange reduces White's control of the centre.
